reasons.correctness: createTicket publishes SupportTicketCreatedEvent through ApplicationEventPublisher and no longer calls EmailService. The event and listener match the interface names and constructor exactly. Build, 56/56 unit and 3/3 acceptance tests are green.
reasons.convention_fit: Listener is in support/ticket/event and uses @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT), @RequiredArgsConstructor, and catch-and-log. Publisher is added to the existing explicit constructor. New *UnitTest uses MockitoExtension and was run.
reasons.design_fit: Mirrors InvoiceCreatedEvent/Listener, the project's existing event pattern. The service change is minimal: the direct call is swapped for publishEvent. No new mechanism and no layering drift.
reasons.test_quality: Listener tests cover the happy path and a swallowed failure; the failure test only implicitly asserts that nothing is thrown. The service test verifies event fields and verifyNoInteractions(emailService) but does not check language. The integration test was inverted to never().
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries found the support/ticket package and the existing *EventListener/event files before any edit. The agent then read InvoiceCreatedEvent and InvoiceCreatedEventListener and modelled the new classes on them.
